items.exampleEn: We saw a bright comet in the night sky.
items.exampleZh: 我們在夜空中看到一顆明亮的彗星。
植物需要水分才能生長。

items.exampleEn: A spider was making a web in the corner.
We collected maple leaves in the park.
items.exampleZh: 我們在公園裡收集楓葉。

items.exampleEn: The calf was born early this morning.
items.exampleZh: 那頭小牛今天一大早出生。

items.exampleEn: Rabbits can breed very quickly in spring.
items.exampleZh: 兔子在春天能很快地繁殖。

items.exampleEn: Many birds live in the wetland near the river.
items.exampleZh: 許多鳥住在河邊的濕地。

items.exampleEn: There are ants all over the kitchen table.
items.exampleZh: 廚房桌上到處都是螞蟻。

items.sentenceEn: There's a spider on your shoulder!
items.sentenceZh: 你的肩膀上有一隻蜘蛛！

items.audioEn: Tonight you can see a comet in the east after nine o'clock.
items.audioZh: 今晚九點以後可以在東方看到一顆彗星。
options: A full moon over the hills.
A comet in the eastern sky.

items.sentenceEn: This table is made of maple.

items.sentenceZh: 農夫飼養乳牛來取得牛奶。

items.stemEn: A young cow is called a ____.
After the rain, there was a lot of ____ in the air.
items.stemZh: 雨後空氣中有很多濕氣。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, our science club visited a wetland outside the city. The ground was full of moisture, so we wore boots. First, we found a huge spider web between two plants. Then we watched a line of ants carrying food back to their home. On a farm next to the wetland, a young calf was drinking milk from its mother. The farmer told us that he keeps cows and sheep. In the fall, the maple trees around the wetland turn bright red. We tried to categorize every animal we saw. That night, our teacher told us that a comet would pass by next month, so we plan to come back and watch it.
items.passageZh: 上週六，我們自然社去城外的一片濕地。地面充滿水分，所以我們穿了雨靴。首先，我們在兩株植物之間發現了一張巨大的蜘蛛網。接著，我們看著一排螞蟻把食物搬回家。在濕地旁的一座農場上，一隻小牛正在喝母牛的奶。農夫告訴我們，他養了牛和羊。到了秋天，濕地周圍的楓樹會變成鮮紅色。我們試著把看到的每種動物分類。那天晚上，老師告訴我們下個月會有一顆彗星經過，所以我們打算再來觀賞。

options: 因為那裡有很多危險的蛇
因為老師說要去河裡抓魚
因為天氣預報說會下大雨
濕地會蓋一座新的農場
